request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red hooded shroud gown becomes a pale bone-white ghostly shroud, warm ivory shaded with warm grey, with a near-black hood lining and a thin bright violet trim along the torn hem; her face and hands become very pale ash grey with no blue; her eyes and open mouth glow bright violet and every small blue flame becomes bright violet. Keep the hair, face, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
